review_method: The saved native PNG was opened with view_image(detail=original) and inspected as one image. No other arm output was used.

criteria.criterion: both short cheek/jaw sections have abrupt blunt lower edges
criteria.evidence: The hair beside both cheeks continues as tapered strands to the collarbone and upper chest; neither side ends as a blunt jaw-length block.

criteria.criterion: a separate rear layer visibly continues below the shoulders
criteria.evidence: Long dark hair continues behind the shoulders and toward the upper back.

criteria.criterion: the front fringe has a straight eyebrow-level edge
criteria.evidence: The forehead fringe is wispy, parted and arched, with individual strands rather than a straight even edge.

cases.summary: A long layered hairstyle is rendered. The defining short blunt cheek sections are absent, so the long rear layer alone cannot pass the hime structure.

criteria.criterion: a headband follows the crown as a separate accessory
criteria.evidence: A black curved band is visible across the crown above the parted hair.

criteria.criterion: two triangular felt ear forms are visible above the crown
criteria.evidence: Two separate fuzzy black triangular pieces rise above the head, one at each side of the band.

criteria.criterion: the triangles are coherently mounted on the headband
criteria.evidence: Both triangular bases meet the curved black band at the crown.

cases.summary: The accessory reads as a physical two-ear headband, with the carrier and its ear attachments visible.

criteria.criterion: outer satin skirt and ivory underlayer have separate readable boundaries
criteria.evidence: The dark garnet satin hem overlaps a recessed cream tiered fabric layer with its own separate lower contour.

criteria.criterion: ivory gathered or ruffled fabric visibly extends below the outer hem
criteria.evidence: Several ivory gathered ruffle tiers extend substantially below the satin hem across the lower skirt.

criteria.criterion: the underskirt contributes a rounded flared skirt volume
criteria.evidence: The satin skirt forms a broad rounded bell contour above the gathered underlayer rather than falling as a flat tube.

cases.summary: A visibly distinct fuller ivory underskirt supports the outer garnet skirt. This is the one adopted integrated candidate, slot:garment_detail:sca_g08.

criteria.criterion: two opposed vertical eyelet rows frame the bodice opening
criteria.evidence: Metal rings form two opposing vertical rows at the center-front bodice opening.

criteria.criterion: one cord makes multiple visible X crossings between those rows
criteria.evidence: Black cord repeats a sequence of clear X crossings from the upper edge down toward the waist.

criteria.criterion: cord is visibly connected to the eyelets and closes the opening
criteria.evidence: The black cord segments meet the metal eyelet holes at both opposing garment edges.

criteria.criterion: the small tied cord bow is readable
criteria.evidence: A tied black knot with loop and hanging ends is visible below the final crossings at the waist.

cases.summary: The front closure has real paired metal eyelets and connected repeated crossed cord rather than an isolated graphic pattern.

data_specific_boundary: Only the petticoat candidate was retrieved and adopted. The other states are independently authored baseline tests, so their pixel results do not establish owner-profile application.
